title: Common providers: Romania
coverage: Partial. Covers the three national operators after the takeover of Telekom Romania Mobile in 2025, and the research network; business ISPs are thin and local networks are not listed.
missing: Local cable and neighbourhood fibre networks (several hundred)
Most business ISPs: only three are listed, and the regulator's register could not be read (its site failed the secure connection)
The government network operator STS (its site did not answer; not a commercial provider)

sources.name: ANCOM (National Authority for Management and Regulation in Communications)
sources.terms: The site did not answer an automated read on the read date and its terms were not read: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Not read: the site did not complete a secure connection on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Romania
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 3 of 7 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Romania
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 7 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 7 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 10 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.
